name: Juren de Jianbang/Mimi de Hei Jiao——Shengdan Tedian Pian
original_name: 巨人的肩膀/秘密的黑礁——圣诞特典篇
source: The end of the year is approaching, and Christmas is coming again. This time, can the unfulfilled long-cherished wish come true...?
translation: The end of the year is approaching, and Christmas is coming again. This time, can the unfulfilled long-cherished wish come true...?
